items.title: Numerical intersection numbers agree with the degree of the iterated first Chern classes capped with the fundamental class
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the numerical intersection number (L_1 ... L_d . Z) of d invertible sheaves against a d-dimensional closed subscheme of a proper scheme over a field with the degree of the iterated cap product of their first Chern classes with the fundamental class, and specialises to the self-intersection of an ample sheaf (statement lines 8180-8198, tag 0BFI). The proof is a genuine three-stage reduction: over the components, then to an H-projective birational model via Chow's lemma, then to the case of a single effective Cartier divisor where the geometric case of the top Chern class converts both sides into the same expression on the divisor, allowing induction on the dimension. Each reduction is an argument in its own right, so the claim is H2.
